title: Listing Review Team Standard — Reinstating a Suspended Listing (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Reinstating a Suspended Listing

*Listing review team standard for Roamhaven Listings.*

## General conditions

1. A suspended listing returns to listed only through a reinstatement request decided by Roamhaven's listing review team.
2. A listing is reinstated only when its reinstatement request has been approved. The request's decision — submitted, approved or denied — is read from the reinstatement request on record.
3. The live-listing limits of Roamhaven Listings apply to every reinstatement.
4. A denied request leaves the listing suspended, and Roamhaven may then remove it.

Support reinstates a suspended listing once its approved reinstatement request and every reinstatement condition are on record.

## Conditions by suspension reason

| Suspension reason | Condition in addition to the approved request |
|---|---|
| quality | reinstated no earlier than the space type's minimum quality-suspension period in calendar days after the suspension date |
| registration | reinstated only after the registration number carried on the approved request has been recorded on the listing |
| host account | reinstated only after the host account is active again |

## Counting the quality period

The days are counted from the listing's suspension date, in calendar days, and reinstatement on the last day of the period is allowed.

| Hypothetical case: suspension date 2026-03-01, period 30 calendar days | Within the time condition? |
|---|---|
| reinstatement on 2026-03-30 | no — the 30 calendar days have not yet run |
| reinstatement on 2026-03-31 | yes — the last day of the period is allowed |
| reinstatement on 2026-04-10 | yes |

The same counting gives 2026-04-30 as the earliest day for a hypothetical 60-day period starting 2026-03-01.

## Points of judgement

- **A request that is still submitted** has not been approved, so the listing is not reinstated.
- **A registration case** in which the approved request carries a number that has not yet been recorded on the listing does not meet the registration condition.
- **A host-account case** in which the host account is still suspended does not meet the host-account condition.
